description: Fork an existing dashboard into a new artifact you own, preserving lineage back to the original (the social remix verb). Use this to adapt a popular dashboard rather than build from scratch — e.g. fork a 'watch pizza' dashboard and raise the budget or add a receipt window via update_dashboard. Increments the source's fork counter. You can fork any public/unlisted artifact, or a private one you own.

id.description: The id (ua_...) of the artifact to fork.

name.description: Optional name for the fork (defaults to '<original> (fork)').

name: fork_dashboard
